title: The Stair Holds
description: Seven layers to this hold. We hold two, and every night they come back up the stair below the Great Hall. Stand one watch on it - I'll not ask an outsider for more.

objectives.description: Go down past the Great Hall to the stair
Break the push on the stair
Silence the archers in the stairwell

notes: Opening skirmish of the Kazan-Dun succession arc. Bible: seven layers, dwarves hold the top two. Gates nothing; the player may walk away after any link in the chain.
